create or alter function [metrics].[GetGovernanceScore] ( @assetUid uniqueidentifier, @effectiveDate date ) returns --declare @measures table ( ParentVersionUid uniqueidentifier, VersionUid uniqueidentifier, [Value] decimal(8,6), [Weight] decimal(8,6), MatchUid uniqueidentifier, OtherMatches nvarchar(max) ) as begin declare @initial table( AssetId bigint, ParentUid uniqueidentifier, AssetUid uniqueidentifier, [Name] nvarchar(250), EffectiveDate datetime, EffectiveEndDate datetime, IsGroup bit, [Weight] float, Threshold float, MatchConditionsOnly bit, [Check] varchar(25), [External] nvarchar(max), [Field] nvarchar(max), [Owner] nvarchar(max), [Predicate] nvarchar(max), [Relation] nvarchar(max), [Uid] uniqueidentifier, Conditions nvarchar(max) );
insert into @initial select v.AssetId, v.ParentUid, v.AssetUid, v.Name, v.EffectiveDate, v.EffectiveEndDate, v.IsGroup, v.Weight, v.Threshold, v.MatchConditionsOnly, v.[Check], v.[External], v.[Field], v.[Owner], v.[Predicate], v.[Relation], v.Uid, metrics.BuildConditionJson(v.Uid) as Conditions from ( select row_number() over(partition by sv.AssetUid order by sv.EffectiveDate desc) as RowNum, sv.*, svd.*, sa.IsGroup, p.Uid as ParentUid, a.Id as AssetId from metrics.AssetVersion sv cross apply openjson(sv.Definition) with ( [Check] varchar(25) '$.Governance.Check', [External] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.External' as json, [Field] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.Field' as json, [Owner] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.Owner' as json, [Predicate] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.Predicate' as json, [Relation] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.Relation' as json ) svd inner join metrics.Asset sa on sa.Uid = sv.AssetUid inner join metrics.Allocation sd on sd.Uid = sa.AllocationUid and sd.ScoreType = 1 inner join dbo.AssetType t on t.Uid = sd.AssetTypeUid inner join dbo.Asset a on a.Uid = @assetUid and a.AssetTypeID = t.Id outer apply ( select pv.Uid from metrics.Asset pa inner join metrics.AssetVersion pv on pv.AssetUid = pa.Uid and pa.Uid = sa.ParentUid and pv.EffectiveDate <= @effectiveDate and (pv.EffectiveEndDate is null or pv.EffectiveEndDate >= @effectiveDate) ) p where sv.EffectiveDate <= @effectiveDate and (sv.EffectiveEndDate is null or sv.EffectiveEndDate >= @effectiveDate) ) v where v.RowNum = 1 order by v.ParentUid, v.Name, v.EffectiveDate
-- Process conditions and load new table --------------------- declare @tbl table( AssetId bigint, ParentUid uniqueidentifier, AssetUid uniqueidentifier, [Name] nvarchar(250), EffectiveDate datetime, EffectiveEndDate datetime, [Weight] float, Threshold float, MatchConditionsOnly bit, [Check] varchar(25), [External] nvarchar(max), [Field] nvarchar(max), [Owner] nvarchar(max), [Predicate] nvarchar(max), [Relation] nvarchar(max), [Uid] uniqueidentifier, Conditions nvarchar(max), MatchUid uniqueidentifier, OtherMatches nvarchar(max), IsGroup bit, AssetTypeId int, -- save on requerying the same tables. FieldTypeId int, -- save on requerying the same tables. [FieldType] varchar(25), -- The data type of the field. [AllowMultipleValues] bit, -- The multiValueAllowed of the field. LookupObject varchar(50), -- In case this is a field compairon for a Lookup field, LookupObjectId int, Operator varchar(50), -- get the operator SingleValue nvarchar(max), -- for single value compairson StartRangeValue nvarchar(max), -- for range comparison EndRangeValue nvarchar(max), -- for range comparisons ListValues nvarchar(max), -- when comparing multiple values. --FieldValue nvarchar(max), --temp, purely for testing Value decimal(8,6) -- The final measure value. );
insert into @tbl (AssetId, AssetTypeId, ParentUid, AssetUid, [Name], EffectiveDate, EffectiveEndDate, [Weight], Threshold, MatchConditionsOnly, [Check], [External], [Field], [Owner], [Predicate], [Relation], [Uid], Conditions, MatchUid, OtherMatches, IsGroup) select m.AssetId, a.AssetTypeId, m.ParentUid, m.AssetUid, m.[Name], m.EffectiveDate, m.EffectiveEndDate, coalesce(cm.[Weight], m.[Weight]), coalesce(cm.Threshold, m.Threshold), m.MatchConditionsOnly, m.[Check], m.[External], m.[Field], m.[Owner], m.[Predicate], m.[Relation], m.[Uid], m.Conditions, cm.MatchUid, cm.OtherMatches, m.IsGroup from @initial m inner join dbo.Asset a on a.ID = m.AssetId cross apply metrics.ConditionsFiltering(m.AssetId, m.Conditions, m.MatchConditionsOnly) cm where cm.[Include] = 1
-- Parse the values to validate for testing. if exists(select 1 from @tbl where [Check] = 'Field') begin update m set m.SingleValue = sV.SingleValue, m.StartRangeValue = rV.StartRangeValue, m.EndRangeValue = rV.EndRangeValue, m.ListValues = mV.[Values], m.AssetTypeId = a.AssetTypeID, m.FieldTypeId = ft.ID, m.FieldType = ft.[Type], m.[AllowMultipleValues] = coalesce(ft.[AllowMultipleValues], 0), m.Operator = c.Operator, m.LookupObject = ft.LookupObjectType + 'Type', m.LookupObjectId = ft.LookupObjectId --,m.FieldValue = f.FormattedValue from @tbl m cross apply openjson(Field) with (FieldTypeName nvarchar(250), [Operator] varchar(25), [Values] nvarchar(max) as json) c inner join dbo.Asset a on a.ID = m.AssetId inner join dbo.FieldType ft on ft.AssetTypeID = a.AssetTypeID and ft.Name = c.FieldTypeName left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = ft.ID cross apply ( select case when c.Operator = 'Between' then case when ft.Type = 'Date' then (select min([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] date '$')) when ft.Type = 'DateTime' then (select min([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] datetime '$')) when ft.Type = 'Decimal' then (select min([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] decimal '$')) when ft.Type = 'Number' then (select min([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] bigint '$')) end else null end as StartRangeValue, case when c.Operator = 'Between' then case when ft.Type = 'Date' then (select max([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] date '$')) when ft.Type = 'DateTime' then (select max([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] datetime '$')) when ft.Type = 'Decimal' then (select max([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] decimal '$')) when ft.Type = 'Number' then (select max([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] bigint '$')) end else null end as EndRangeValue ) rV cross apply ( select case when c.Operator in ('Between', 'In', 'NotIn') then null else (select top 1 [Value] from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max) '$')) end as SingleValue ) sV cross apply ( select case when c.Operator in ('In', 'NotIn') then ( select [Value] from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max) '$') for json path ) else null end as [Values] ) mV where m.[Check] = 'Field' end -- Now process each Governance check -------------------------
-- External measure check. if exists(select 1 from @tbl where [Check] = 'External') begin delete m from @tbl m inner join dbo.Asset a on a.Id = m.AssetId left join metrics.ExternalMeasureResult r on r.AssetUid = a.[Uid] and r.AssetVersionUid = m.Uid and r.EffectiveDate = @effectiveDate where m.[Check] = 'External' and r.AssetUid is null and m.IsGroup = 0;
update m set m.[Value] = iif(r.[Value] = 1, 1, 0) from @tbl m inner join dbo.Asset a on a.Id = m.AssetId inner join metrics.ExternalMeasureResult r on r.AssetUid = a.[Uid] and r.AssetVersionUid = m.Uid and r.EffectiveDate = @effectiveDate where m.[Check] = 'External' and m.IsGroup = 0; end
-- Non-lookups, checking Populated/NotPopulated
if exists(select 1 from @tbl m where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType <> 'Lookup' and m.Operator in ('Populated', 'NotPopulated')) begin update m set m.[Value] = case when m.Operator = 'Populated' and (coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) is not null and coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) <> '') then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotPopulated' and (coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) is null or coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) = '') then 1 else 0 end from @tbl m inner join dbo.Asset a on a.ID = m.AssetId inner join dbo.FieldType ft on ft.AssetTypeID = a.AssetTypeID and ft.ID = m.FieldTypeId left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType <> 'Lookup' and m.Operator in ('Populated', 'NotPopulated') end
-- Non-lookups, skipping Populated/NotPopulated
if exists(select 1 from @tbl m where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType <> 'Lookup' and m.Value is null and m.Operator not in ('Populated', 'NotPopulated')) begin update m set m.[Value] = case when m.FieldType = 'Boolean' then case when m.Operator = 'IsTrue' and lower(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue)) in ('true', '1') then 1 when m.Operator = 'IsFalse' and lower(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue)) in ('false', '0') then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'Date' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as date) = try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue,'1900-01-01') as date) <> try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator = 'Between' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as date) between try_parse(m.StartRangeValue as date) and try_parse(m.EndRangeValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator in ('After', 'GreaterThan') and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as date) > try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator in ('OnOrAfter', 'GreaterThanOrEquals') and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as date) >= try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator in ('Before', 'LessThan') and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as date) < try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator in ('OnOrBefore', 'LessThanOrEquals') and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as date) <= try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'DateTime' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as datetime) = try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue,'1900-01-01') as datetime) <> try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator = 'Between' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as datetime) between try_parse(m.StartRangeValue as datetime) and try_parse(m.EndRangeValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator in ('After', 'GreaterThan') and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as datetime) > try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator in ('OnOrAfter', 'GreaterThanOrEquals') and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as datetime) >= try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator in ('Before', 'LessThan') and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as datetime) < try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator in ('OnOrBefore', 'LessThanOrEquals') and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as datetime) <= try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'Decimal' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as decimal) = try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue, '-1') as decimal) <> try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'Between' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as decimal) between try_parse(m.StartRangeValue as decimal) and try_parse(m.EndRangeValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'GreaterThan' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as decimal) > try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'GreaterThanOrEquals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as decimal) >= try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'LessThan' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as decimal) < try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'LessThanOrEquals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as decimal) <= try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'Number' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as bigint) = try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue, '-1') as bigint) <> try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 when m.Operator = 'Between' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as bigint) between try_parse(m.StartRangeValue as bigint) and try_parse(m.EndRangeValue as bigint) then 1 when m.Operator = 'GreaterThan' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as bigint) > try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 when m.Operator = 'GreaterThanOrEquals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as bigint) >= try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint)then 1 when m.Operator = 'LessThan' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as bigint) < try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint)then 1 when m.Operator = 'LessThanOrEquals' and try_parse(coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) as bigint) <= try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'Text' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) = m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue,'') <> m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'Contains' and coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) like '%' + m.SingleValue + '%' then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotContains' and coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) not like '%' + m.SingleValue + '%' then 1 when m.Operator = 'StartsWith' and coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) like m.SingleValue + '%' then 1 when m.Operator = 'EndsWith' and coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) like '%' + m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'In' and coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue) in ( select v.[Value] from openjson(m.[ListValues]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotIn' and coalesce(f.FormattedValue, ft.DefaultFormattedValue,'') not in ( select v.[Value] from openjson(m.[ListValues]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 else 0 end
else 0 end from @tbl m inner join dbo.Asset a on a.ID = m.AssetId inner join dbo.FieldType ft on ft.AssetTypeID = a.AssetTypeID and ft.ID = m.FieldTypeId left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType <> 'Lookup' and m.Value is null and m.Operator not in ('Populated', 'NotPopulated') end
-- Perform Lookup Populated check
if exists(select 1 from @tbl m where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator = 'Populated') begin declare @tempobjectids table (FieldTypeId int, AssetId bigint, ObjectID int, AssetTypeID int); declare @tempobjectidsPresent table (FieldTypeId int, AssetId bigint);
insert into @tempobjectids select m.FieldTypeId,m.AssetId,vals.ObjectID,lt.ID AssetTypeID from @tbl m inner join dbo.FieldType ft on ft.ID = m.FieldTypeId left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId left join dbo.AssetType lt on lt.Object = m.LookupObject and lt.ObjectID = m.LookupObjectId cross apply (select try_parse(value as int) as ObjectID from string_split(coalesce(f.Value, ft.DefaultValue, '-1'), ',') ) vals where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator = 'Populated' group by m.FieldTypeId,m.AssetId,vals.ObjectID,lt.ID;
insert into @tempobjectidsPresent select m.FieldTypeId,m.AssetId from @tempobjectids m inner join dbo.Asset la on la.AssetTypeID = m.AssetTypeID and la.ObjectID = m.ObjectID where m.AssetTypeID is not null group by m.FieldTypeId,m.AssetId;
update m set m.[Value] = iif(a.FieldTypeId is not null, 1, 0) -- we are not validating the specific value - just that the field value is not null and it does point to a valid asset. from @tbl m left join @tempobjectidsPresent a on m.FieldTypeId = a.FieldTypeId and m.AssetId = a.AssetId where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator = 'Populated' end
---- Perform Lookup NotPopulated check
if exists(select 1 from @tbl m where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator = 'NotPopulated') begin update m set m.[Value] = iif(a.Present = 0, 1, 0) from @tbl m inner join dbo.FieldType ft on ft.ID = m.FieldTypeId left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId outer apply ( select count(1) as Present from dbo.AssetType lt cross apply ( select try_parse(value as int) as ObjectID from string_split(coalesce(f.Value, ft.DefaultValue, '-1'), ',') ) vals inner join dbo.Asset la on la.AssetTypeID = lt.ID and lt.Object = m.LookupObject and lt.ObjectID = m.LookupObjectId and la.ObjectID = vals.ObjectID ) a where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator = 'NotPopulated' end
-- Perform Lookup other check
if exists(select 1 from @tbl m where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator not in ('Populated', 'NotPopulated')) begin update m set m.[Value] = iif(a.Present > 0, 1, 0) from @tbl m inner join dbo.FieldType ft on ft.ID = m.FieldTypeId left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId outer apply ( select count(1) as Present from dbo.AssetType lt cross apply ( select try_parse(value as int) as ObjectID from string_split(coalesce(f.Value, ft.DefaultValue, '-1'), ',') ) vals inner join dbo.Asset la on la.AssetTypeID = lt.ID and lt.Object = m.LookupObject and lt.ObjectID = m.LookupObjectId and la.ObjectID = vals.ObjectID and case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and la.Uid = m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and la.Uid <> m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'In' and la.Uid in ( select v.[Value] from openjson(m.[ListValues]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotIn' and la.Uid not in ( select v.[Value] from openjson(m.[ListValues]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 else 0 end = 1 ) a where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator not in ('Populated', 'NotPopulated') end
-- OWNERSHIP -----------------------------------------------
if exists(select 1 from @tbl m where m.[Check] = 'Owner') begin update m set m.[Value] = case when c.Operator = 'Populated' and o.Present = 1 and rt.ID is not null then 1 when c.Operator = 'NotPopulated' and (o.Present is null or rt.ID is null) then 1 else 0 end from @tbl m cross apply openjson([Owner]) with (ResponsibilityTypeUid uniqueidentifier, [Operator] varchar(25)) c left join [security].[Role] rt on rt.Uid = c.ResponsibilityTypeUid outer apply (select max(Present) Present from (select 1 as Present from [dbo].[ResponsibilitySummary] rsa where rsa.ResponsibilityTypeID = rt.ID and rsa.AssetID = m.AssetId union All select 1 as Present from [dbo].[ResponsibilitySummary] rsat where rsat.ResponsibilityTypeID = rt.ID and rsat.AssetID = 0 and rsat.AssetTypeID = m.AssetTypeId and rsat.ApplyToType = 1 ) r ) o where m.[Check] = 'Owner' end
-- PREDICATE ----------------------------------------------- if exists(select 1 from @tbl m where m.[Check] = 'Predicate') begin update m set m.[Value] = case when c.Operator = 'Populated' and o.Present = 1 then 1 when c.Operator = 'NotPopulated' and o.Present is null then 1 else 0 end from @tbl m cross apply openjson([Predicate]) with (PredicateUid uniqueidentifier, [Operator] varchar(25)) c outer apply ( select top 1 1 as Present from [dbo].[Intersect] I inner join [IntersectType] IT on I.IntersectTypeID = IT.ID inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.[Uid] = c.PredicateUid where (I.SubjectAssetID = m.AssetId) union select top 1 1 as Present from [dbo].[Intersect] I inner join [IntersectType] IT on I.IntersectTypeID = IT.ID inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.[Uid] = c.PredicateUid where (I.ObjectAssetID = m.AssetId) ) o where m.[Check] = 'Predicate' end
-- RELATION ------------------------------------------------ if exists(select 1 from @tbl m where m.[Check] = 'Relation') begin update m set m.[Value] = case when c.Operator = 'Populated' and o.Present = 1 then 1 when c.Operator = 'NotPopulated' and o.Present is null then 1 else 0 end from @tbl m cross apply openjson([Relation]) with (IntersectTypeUid uniqueidentifier, [Operator] varchar(25)) c outer apply ( select top 1 1 as Present from [dbo].[IntersectType] IT inner join [intersect] I on I.IntersectTypeID = IT.ID and I.SubjectAssetID = m.AssetId where IT.[Uid] = c.IntersectTypeUid union select top 1 1 as Present from [dbo].[IntersectType] IT inner join [intersect] I on I.IntersectTypeID = IT.ID and I.ObjectAssetID = m.AssetId where IT.[Uid]= c.IntersectTypeUid ) o where m.[Check] = 'Relation' end
-- Remove those measure groups that do not have any representative descendant measures. delete @tbl where IsGroup = 1 and Uid not in (select distinct ParentUid from @tbl where ParentUid is not null);
insert into @measures (ParentVersionUid, VersionUid, Value, Weight, MatchUid, OtherMatches) select ParentUid, Uid, [Value], Weight, MatchUid, OtherMatches from @tbl;
